ranked_findings.finding: The idempotency-required guardrail was bypassed via legacy_batch_header, allowing duplicate bulk refunds
evidence: corpus/timeline/incident_timeline.md: 10:18 UTC guardrail skipped due to legacy_batch_header
corpus/tickets/TICKET-8729.md: all duplicates have request_class=bulk-refund and no idempotency key

ranked_findings.finding: Bulk refund requests without idempotency keys caused duplicate refunds for three enterprise accounts
evidence: corpus/tickets/TICKET-8721.md: duplicate refunds observed for three enterprise accounts

unresolved_ambiguity: The initial theory in TICKET-8721 suggested a queue worker replay caused the duplicates, but this was opened before API gateway logs were available. Evidence from TICKET-8729 indicates the root cause was missing idempotency keys, not worker replay.
